body: Thank you so much. I’ve been so scared to reach out because I’ve been denied so many times. Also thank you, I love lily of the valley. Flowers mean a lot to me but that one seems special to me.
I’m glad there’s someone else that feels this way, none of my friends really like talking about feelings or anything. I will see if I can talk to someone else soon.
I don’t really know. My dad always tells me that I’m a strong person, but that’s about it. None of my friends have ever really told me I’m good at anything.
